requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeted at unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs, with 5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, and AMPV of ~500 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To fill the gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and address SMB needs for cost-effective, high-performance, and efficient printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer released and available for SMBs with specified features and performance, targeting the defined customer segment.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate breakthrough AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: To differentiate HP Magellan with advanced AI features, improving productivity and ease of management for SMBs without dedicated IT.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered features implemented and validated for productivity, scan workflow, and manageability in SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan delivers HP's lowest total cost of ownership for SMBs, with minimal intervention and maximum efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: To attract SMBs seeking ROI and efficiency, and to compete effectively in the CISS segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculations and competitive benchmarks demonstrate lowest TCO for SMB segment.

requirements.Title: Sustainability - 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Magellan must use at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP) in its construction, exceeding competitors like Epson (30%).
requirements.Rationale: To meet sustainability goals and provide a competitive advantage in eco-friendly printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM and manufacturing reports confirm 60% RCP usage.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by customers (PHA), with service center fallback if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce maintenance costs and downtime for SMBs, especially those without IT support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable; documentation and testing confirm ease of replacement.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure proper installation.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize user mistakes and improve reliability for SMB users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles implemented; usability testing confirms effectiveness.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage their printers, targeting unmanaged and lightly managed environments.
requirements.Rationale: To enable easy device management for SMBs without IT teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal deployed and validated for SMB device management scenarios.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: To support modern SMB workflows and increase convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing tested and validated through HP App.

requirements.Title: Warranty - 80k pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To provide assurance and reliability for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; reliability testing supports warranty claims.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Ensure serviceability with PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center threshold, target customer replaceable if out of warranty).
requirements.Rationale: To minimize downtime and support SMBs without IT teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Serviceability documented and tested for both PHA and MINK scenarios.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must support speed of 25/20 min (improved from current 25/19), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: To meet performance and regulatory requirements for specific SMB segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU validated for speed, PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKU must support SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: To address varied SMB needs and provide differentiated solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU features implemented and validated.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement AI-powered 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' solutions for superior output quality and workflow automation.
requirements.Rationale: To differentiate Magellan and address key SMB pain points around productivity and quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI solutions validated for print and scan quality and workflow efficiency.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Printing-as-a-Service (PaaS) for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: To enable flexible business models and align with HP's strategic goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan validated for PaaS support and scenarios.

requirements.Title: Maintenance Free or Less Maintenance
requirements.Description: Design Magellan for maintenance-free or reduced maintenance operation with fewer parts to replace over product life.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize operational disruption and support SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance claims validated through testing and documentation.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and support.
requirements.Rationale: To enable proactive support and device management for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features deployed and validated for SMB scenarios.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal Solutions Enhancement with AI
requirements.Description: Enhance SMB portal solutions with AI capabilities for device management, support, and workflow automation.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and operational efficiency for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI enhancements validated in SMB portal solutions.

requirements.Title: Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Provide an advanced view in the SMB portal for device status, analytics, and actionable insights.
requirements.Rationale: To empower SMBs with data-driven management tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Advanced view features implemented and validated.

requirements.Title: Competitive Benchmarking and Claims
requirements.Description: Substantiate 'first', 'best', 'only' claims with competitive benchmarking and test data (e.g., 2X speed, 50% less setup time).
requirements.Rationale: To support marketing and product positioning with credible data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Claims documented and supported by test data and benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Geographical Sales Potential Ranking
requirements.Description: Identify and rank top 5/10 geographical areas for sales potential and tailor product rollout accordingly.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize market impact and prioritize high-potential regions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Sales potential ranking documented and integrated into launch plan.
